sideCard.title: Something not covered?
sideCard.description: Ask a founder directly. Replies usually land the same day.

items.question: Are you an agency or a product company?
items.answer: Both, deliberately. Roughly 60% of the team works on client engagements and 40% on our own products. The lab work is why our client work is good — we hit the same problems in production and bring the answers with us.

items.question: How quickly can you start?
items.answer: Scoping calls usually happen within 48 hours. A Sprint can typically start within two weeks; a full Retainer squad takes three to four weeks to assemble. If you're on fire, tell us — we hold a small amount of capacity for exactly that.

items.question: Who owns the code and IP?
items.answer: You do, entirely, from the first commit. We work in your repository under your license. Anything we build for you is yours; anything we bring in is either open source or licensed to you perpetually at no cost.

items.question: Do you work with early-stage startups?
items.answer: Yes, and often at a discount for pre-seed teams solving something we find genuinely interesting. We occasionally take part of the fee in equity, but only when we'd have wanted to invest anyway.

items.question: What happens when the engagement ends?
items.answer: You get recorded architecture walkthroughs, decision records, an on-call runbook, and two weeks of overlap with your team at no charge. We plan the handover from the first sprint, not the last.

items.question: Can we hire your engineers directly?
items.answer: If someone on the team wants to join you full time, we won't stand in the way — no poaching fee, no drama. It's happened four times and we still work with all four companies.
